hero.lede: Selected work by Phil Parry: a Shopify store, a design system and catalogue tools for a supplier of research-grade vaccine adjuvants.

scene.label: STR, step by step
scene.title: A shop for buyers who don't browse.

steps.title: The buyers
steps.note: STR sells research-grade vaccine adjuvants to scientists. The products are white powders in near-identical vials, so buyers compare formulation, purity and documentation before they trust a supplier.

stage.alt: The live STR homepage: Defined adjuvants for vaccine research, with ready-to-use adjuvants and defined synthetic components
stage.caption: The live homepage at strsg.com.

steps.title: Written for scientists
steps.note: The voice is set in the design system as scientific, never salesy: precise claims backed by data, and no marketing language a researcher would discount on sight.

dont: “Our amazing product boosts vaccines like never before.”
stage.caption: Examples from the writing rules in the STR design system.

steps.title: A mark with a signal
steps.note: The logo was explored through seven routes, from a literal QS-21 structure to rounded geometry. The live mark adds a small green dot: a quiet signal of reliability.

final.alt: The live STR mark with its green dot

stage.caption: Five of the routes in the design system, converging on the live mark.

steps.title: One palette
steps.note: A deep laboratory blue carries the brand, with a teal and a trust green held back for status. The same palette brands the shop, the checkout and the customer accounts.

stage.caption: From the colour page of the STR design system.

steps.title: A reference that takes orders
steps.note: Product pages lead with what a scientist checks: formulation, purity, pack sizes and documentation, set like instrument output. Ordering sits beside the data, not in place of it.

desktop.alt: A01 Squalene Emulsion Adjuvant product page on desktop

phone.alt: The same product page on a phone

steps.title: A theme of its own
steps.note: I built the Shopify theme from scratch rather than adapting a bought one, so it carries only what this catalogue needs. Shopify's own speed report rates it Good.

stage.alt: Shopify admin: the STR theme with its Core Web Vitals rated Good
stage.caption: The STR theme in Shopify admin, with Shopify's speed report.

steps.title: Publishing the client runs
steps.note: The client team runs the catalogue themselves. A spreadsheet stays the source of truth, and a catalogue manager shows what is draft, ready or live before anything reaches the shop.

stage.alt: Catalogue manager: draft, ready and live counts above a sortable product table
stage.caption: Client-review prototype, running on sample data.

steps.title: Live at strsg.com
steps.note: The storefront went live at strsg.com in time for World Vaccine Congress Europe in Amsterdam, and reads as well on a phone as at a desk.

photos.alt: A product page on a phone
